body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Barcelona, Spain. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 10 km. It starts at Poble Espanyol, Av. de Francesc Ferrer i Guàrdia, Calle de los Caballeros, 13, Distrito de Sants-Montjuïc, 08038 Barcelona, Spain. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Skip The Line Ticket to Poble Espanyol. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> This sightseeing walking tour introduces Barcelona through its art, architecture, and history, making it ideal for first-time visitors and anyone curious about how the city grew from a medieval port to a modern capital of Catalan creativity. Your exploration includes your ticket to Poble Espanyol theme park, paving the way for a cultural journey through the city's storied streets.
>
> Note! While an audio guide inside Poble Espanyol isn't included in this tour, the visual feast and the stories told en route of the city walk provide a fulfilling experience.
>
> From Poble Espanyol, the route leads past the National Art Museum of Catalonia, historic gardens, the Albéniz Palace area, the Joan Miró Foundation, the Greek Theatre, and the Civil War shelter Refugi 307. From there, it descends to the waterfront at the Columbus Monument, then enters the old city through Santa Maria del Mar, Barcelona Cathedral, Bishop’s Bridge, Sant Felip Neri Square, La Rambla, and Plaça de Catalunya. The final stretch follows Passeig de Gràcia to Casa Batlló, La Pedrera, and ends at La Sagrada Família.
>
> Along the way, you will experience sweeping views from Montjuïc, shaded garden paths, traces of wartime Barcelona, Gothic stone streets, bustling boulevards, and Gaudí’s dreamlike facades. Memorable moments include the rose window of Santa Maria del Mar, the scarred walls of Sant Felip Neri, the lively rhythm of La Rambla, and the towering spires and colored glass of La Sagrada Família.
